title: Rene Haas, once touted as possible Nvidia successor, commits to lead Arm to 2033

title: Analysis: Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia, but he is returning to a changed board
snippet: Nvidia's board took six days to go from ruling out Jensen Huang's return to reinstating him. Despite that, its own filings show the founder will be coming back to a different company. Nvidia now has its first board chair, an ongoing investigation, and a new layer of national security oversight. All three took shape while Huang was gone.

title: IPC makers see no AI project delays after US midterms as edge server inquiries rise
snippet: Several industrial PC (IPC) makers said their AI-related projects are proceeding as planned, with no clear delays so far, even as the market reassesses the returns on heavy AI spending by cloud service providers (CSPs) amid uncertainty over US energy and AI policy following the midterm elections. Some said customer inquiries for edge servers have increased.

title: China's full-color Micro LED AR glasses expose South Korea's supply chain vulnerability
snippet: Chinese manufacturers have taken the lead in integrating RGB full-color Micro LED displays into both lenses of augmented reality (AR) glasses, gaining an early advantage in the emerging market. China's vertically integrated supply chain, spanning materials, components, and finished products, has raised concerns in South Korea that Chinese companies could dominate the market once demand accelerates.

title: Sarvam's foreign-model platform tests India's AI-sovereignty goals
snippet: Sarvam's decision to host Chinese-developed AI models on Indian infrastructure is putting a practical question at the center of India's push for technological independence: whether sovereignty depends on owning the models, controlling the computing infrastructure, or both.

title: Malaysia Tells Data Centers to Cut Off Firms on US Blacklist
snippet: Malaysia will advise data-center operators not to host, lease space or provide services to seven companies newly placed on a US trade blacklist, stepping up efforts to prevent the country’s booming industry from being used to circumvent American technology restrictions.

title: Fujitsu CTO on AI Focus & Outlook
